source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: The low/high opposition in syntactic bundling
notes: Finally, both IP-reflexives and benefactives can cooccur with causative suffixes. However, whereas –n- in IP-reflexives can only precede the causative marker, -n- in benefactives has two options of realization, either before or after the causative marker.
en: Sardaana made Michil sew a coat for his own (Michil’s) benefit.
